news.headline: Nektar Sets Q2 2026 Earnings Date and Webcast for August 13
news.summary: Nektar confirmed it will report second-quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday, August 13, after U.S. market close, with CEO Howard Robin hosting a 5:00pm ET conference call. As of this refresh (mid-afternoon Aug 13, pre-release) results were not yet out; investors are watching for cash-runway updates and commentary on the newly dosing ZENITH AD Phase 3 program.

news.headline: Canaccord Genuity Initiates Nektar at Buy with $153 Price Target
news.summary: Canaccord Genuity analyst Edward Nash started coverage of Nektar with a Buy rating and a $153 price target, citing the newly launched Phase 3 ZENITH AD program for rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis. The initiation added to a broadly bullish sell-side stance on the stock heading into the back half of 2026.

news.headline: Nektar Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program for Rezpegaldesleukin
news.summary: Nektar announced the initiation of its first two global registrational trials, ZENITH AD-1 and ZENITH AD-2, evaluating rezpegaldesleukin in biologic/JAK-inhibitor-naive patients 12 and older with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis. A third trial, ZENITH AD-3, enrolling patients with prior systemic biologic or JAK-inhibitor experience, is planned to begin in September 2026, with initial ZENITH AD data expected in mid-2028 and a targeted BLA filing in 2029.

news.headline: Nektar Reports Inducement Stock Option Grants to 23 New Hires
news.summary: Nektar's compensation committee granted non-qualified stock options for 36,000 shares to 23 newly hired employees under its 2025 Inducement Plan, priced at $64.84 (the July 20 closing price). The filing signals continued headcount build-out as the company ramps up for its Phase 3 ZENITH AD program.

news.headline: Nektar Shares Rally as Immunology Sector Sentiment Improves
news.summary: NKTR shares jumped over 10% intraday to close near $71, extending a multi-week climb from the mid-$50s, as broader immunology-sector optimism and anticipation of the imminent Phase 3 ZENITH AD start drove buying interest. The move came about three weeks before the official Phase 3 dosing announcement.

catalysts.when: 2026-08-13, after U.S. market close (~5:00pm ET / ~21:00 UTC)
catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Nektar reports second-quarter 2026 financial results and hosts a conference call; as of this update (~19:20 UTC) results had not yet been released. Key items to watch: revenue, net loss/EPS, cash & investments (Q1 2026 was $731.6M after the Q1 capital raises), operating expense trajectory, and any commentary on ZENITH AD-1/AD-2 enrollment progress.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 Phase 3 trial start
catalysts.detail: Third registrational trial in the ZENITH AD program, enrolling atopic dermatitis patients with prior systemic biologic and/or JAK-inhibitor experience, is set to begin dosing.

catalysts.label: TrialNet Phase 2 Type 1 diabetes study
catalysts.detail: Rezpegaldesleukin is being evaluated in a TrialNet-run Phase 2 study in new-onset Type 1 diabetes; no specific readout date has been disclosed.

catalysts.label: Initial ZENITH AD-1/AD-2 Phase 3 topline data
catalysts.detail: Company-guided timeline for first Phase 3 atopic dermatitis data from the ZENITH AD program, ahead of a targeted 2029 BLA submission.

catalysts.label: Alopecia areata Phase 3 program initiation
catalysts.detail: Following positive 52-week REZOLVE-AA Phase 2b extension data (April 2026), Nektar has said it plans to advance rezpegaldesleukin into a registrational alopecia areata program, leveraging its Fast Track designation; timing has not been formally announced.

pulse: Nektar heads into today's Q2 2026 report (due after close, ~21:00 UTC) with results not yet released as of this update, trading around $75-76 after a strong summer run driven by the July 21 dosing start of the pivotal ZENITH AD-1/AD-2 Phase 3 trials in atopic dermatitis. Sell-side sentiment has turned notably bullish, highlighted by Canaccord Genuity's July 22 Buy initiation ($153 target), alongside continued hiring to support the Phase 3 build-out. The key swing factors this quarter are cash runway sufficiency into the multi-year ZENITH AD program (data guided for mid-2028) and any update on the September-scheduled ZENITH AD-3 start.
